visual_elements: This list describes facts related to the Pullman Strike of 1894.
The Pullman Company makes railcars and creates a town for its workers to live in.
An economic crisis decreases Pullman Company’s profits, leading to wage cuts but no decrease in workers’ rents.
Pullman ignores its workers’ demands, leading to a strike and national boycott of Pullman cars.
The federal government becomes involved after mail delivery is affected.
